description_en: Invoke the SubmitOperationAuditInfo API to submit self-service business review information
description_zh: 调用SubmitOperationAuditInfo提交自助业务审核信息
name: SubmitOperationAuditInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The domain name. You can specify one or more domain names, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 域名。支持一个或多个域名，多个域名之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The business type. Valid values:

1: Transfer a domain name offline, that is, transfer the domain name from the current Alibaba Cloud account to another Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型。取值：

1：线下转移域名，即将域名从当前的阿里云账号转移至另一个阿里云账号
parameters.name: audit_type

parameters.example: 个人 {"regType":1,"registrantName":"张三","registrantNo":"2201919190**","telephone":"1390123****","account":"zhangsan@alimail.com","reason":1,"remark":"账号丢失"} 企业 {"regType":2,"registrantName":"华大信通","operatorName":"王武","operatorNo":"2201811987101901**",      "operatorPhone":"1390123****","account":"wangwu@alimail.com","companyNo":"91361100MA35N6****","reason":2,"remark":"账号丢失"}
parameters.help_en: The information to be reviewed. The displayed information varies by business type
parameters.help_zh: 待审核信息，不同的业务类型显示的信息不同
parameters.name: audit_info
